engineering_summary.io: ET 200SP HA: 2x 16AI 2-wire HART + 9x 4AI 2/4-wire HART ISOL = 68 physical AI channels
engineering_summary.vrf_gateway: 3 x IRTrans IRT-MED-Mod inside PN-AUT-001. Project/supplier design limit frozen at 12 indoor units per gateway: 36 installed endpoint capacity for 32 indoor units, 4 spare. IRTrans official documentation states up to 15 IRTrans Bus Modules per Mediacontroller; the stricter 12-endpoint project limit governs.
engineering_summary.temperature: Endress+Hauser TMT72 HART field-mount architecture, TEMP-WM retained as application reference
engineering_summary.co2: Omniguard Model 3100 configured CO2 0-5000 ppm, 4-20mA + HART Rev7, 24Vdc nominal
engineering_summary.cooling: Schneider ClimaSys CU NSYCU350DG, 350W L35-L35 / 240W L35-L50
engineering_summary.cooling_ip_issue: NSYCU350DG internal circuit is IP55; therefore the requested final IP66 assembly is NOT proven and remains the only release blocker.
engineering_summary.enclosure: Current project envelope 1200x800x300 mm remains a candidate only. It must be revalidated by real-scale layout with 3 gateways, 3 CM-GW, 1 CM-VFD and DC/DC gateway supplies before render. No automatic increase is allowed without capacity proof.
engineering_summary.gateway_distribution: GW-HVAC-01=12 indoor units; GW-HVAC-02=12; GW-HVAC-03=8; total 32.
engineering_summary.gateway_field_modules: 32 x IRT-Bus-Mod in field, one per independently addressed indoor unit.
engineering_summary.gateway_serial_interfaces: 3 x Siemens CM PtP RS232 HF 6ES7541-1AD01-0AB0, one point-to-point RS232 interface per gateway.
engineering_summary.vfd_serial_interface: 1 x Siemens CM PtP RS422/485 HF 6ES7541-1AB01-0AB0 for VFD-01 + VFD-02 per user-provided LI screenshot.
engineering_summary.gateway_power: IRT-MED-Mod official hardware requires 8-16 Vdc external supply depending on variant/mainboard. Because the panel UPS bus is 24 Vdc, add dedicated 24->12 Vdc conversion. Exact DC/DC rating remains HOLD until field bus-module load per segment is verified.

thermal_basis.note: Field transmitters are outside enclosure and are excluded from internal heat, but included in UPS load.

release_gate.blocker: Schneider NSYCU350DG declares IP55 internal circuit. The final IP66 assembly requested by the project is not demonstrated by manufacturer documentation.
blockers: Exact 24->12 Vdc DC/DC converter rating for the three IRTrans bus segments requires verified total bus-module current.
Real-scale panel layout must be rerun with 3 gateways + 3 CM-GW + 1 CM-VFD + gateway DC/DC supplies before enclosure size is frozen.
Gateway endpoint spare is 4/36 (11.1% of installed capacity); three gateways follow the explicit user decision, not a 20% gateway-capacity reserve.
Final IP66 assembly proof with cooling remains pending.
Image MODEL 001 is blocked until LI R05 and dimensional layout are frozen.

gateway_capacity.condenser_rule: Do not consume IRTrans indoor-unit addresses unless HVAC manufacturer topology explicitly requires it.
gateway_capacity.manufacturer_reference_note: IRTrans official page states up to 15 Bus Modules per Mediacontroller; project uses stricter supplier design limit of 12.
gateway_capacity.reserve_policy_note: Three gateways satisfy the explicit user decision and current 32-unit scope. If the general 20% future-capacity rule is later extended to gateway endpoints, four gateways would be required.

dimensioning_recheck.conclusion: Adding 3 small Mediacontrollers and 3 RS232 CMs does not by itself prove a larger enclosure is required. Re-run the complete real-scale layout including UPS, batteries, I/O, terminals, ducts, DC/DC converters and 20% physical reserve. Keep 1200x800x300 as candidate until that layout gate passes.
